Elections 

2026 General Election





 

 
 
November 3, 2026
 General Election 
 

 A General Election is the election in which federal and state officers, members of Congress and of the general assembly, county and township officers, and other officers appear on the ballot. General Elections are held the 1st Tuesday after the 1st Monday in November of each even-numbered year. 

 
 
 

 Results will be posted on election night.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Public Notice
 






 
Satellite Absentee Voting Information 
 

 
NOTICE
 
SATELLITE ABSENTEE VOTING STATIONS
 
2026 GENERAL ELECTION 
 

I, Tibe Vander Linden, Commissioner of Elections of Muscatine County, hereby give notice that Satellite Voting Stations have been established for the November 3, 2026, General Election at the following locations: 
 

Wilton Community Center 
 
 
 
1215 Cypress Street, Wilton, Iowa 
 
Friday, October 16, 2026 
 
Satellite Absentee voting opens at 12:00 P.M. and closes at 6:00 P.M 
 
 

West Liberty Public Library 
 
 
 
400 N. Spencer St., West Liberty, Iowa 
 
Sunday, October 18, 2026 
 
Satellite Absentee voting opens at 11:00 A.M. and closes at 5:00 P.M. 
 
Sunday, October 25, 2026 
 
Satellite Absentee voting opens at 11:00 A.M. and closes at 5:00 P.M. 
 
 

Muscatine Community College- McAvoy Center 
 
 
 
1403 Park Avenue, Muscatine, Iowa 
 
Saturday, October 24, 2026 
 
Satellite Absentee voting opens at 9:00 A.M. and closes at 3:00 P.M. 
 
 

Muscatine County Auditor’s Office 
 
 
 
414 East 3rd Street, Suite 201, Muscatine, Iowa 
 
Saturday, October 24, 2026 
 
Satellite Absentee voting opens at 8:00 A.M. and closes at 2:00 P.M. 
 
 

Ballots will be available for all precincts of Muscatine County. All eligible voters of Muscatine County may vote absentee at the above locations. Voter registration forms will be available for new registrations and changes to registrations for people already registered in Muscatine County. 
 

Absentee voting is also conducted on weekdays from 8:00 A.M. until 4:30 P.M. in the Auditor’s Office located at 414 E. Third Street, Suite 201, Muscatine, IA, from October 14, 2026 through November 2, 2026.The Auditor’s Office will also be open from 8:00 A.M. until 5:00 P.M. on Saturday, October 31, 2026. 
 

Tibe Vander Linden
 
Muscatine County Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
